technique_name: Describe why it is necessary to have a diverse workforce.
description: Employing individuals from multiple backgrounds promotes the implementation and acceptance of innovative ideas and solutions. By having a diverse workforce and placing value on the unique contributions of each team member, companies can create a competitive edge for themselves in the market. A diverse workforce is necessary for organizations to boost creativity, innovation, and collaboration.
